about: Jeremy's learn-anything goal (2026-11-04): links or documents, a brief, study cards, saved to a folder. Two source stages make links and the folder optional with one either-or group; study_cards after write_brief takes its material from the brief and asks for nothing; the custom save stage writes into the folder the user names.
